text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 4. Write these numbers in words a. 53 b. 25 c. 19 d. 73 5. Count forward and fill in the blanks. a. 482, _____, _____, _____, 486, _____ b. 498, _____, _____, 501, _____, _____ 6. Count backwards and fill in the blanks. a. 823, _____, _____, _____, 819, _____ b. 628, _____, 626, _____, _____, _____ 7. Write these numbers in expanded form. a. 704 b. 385 c. 980 d. 341 8. What is the value of 5 in 527? 9. Which digit is in tens place in 108? Topic 2 Comparing and Ordering Adventure begins! Bunty's family has a tradition of planting a tree when a family member is born. Abbu 438 months Ammi 432 months Lali 192 months Babloo 120 months Bunty 108 months 9
